recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century music album cover featuring a full-body photograph of a man and woman dancing back-to-back in a 'twist' pose, set against a high-key, slightly textured white background with bold, multi-colored sans-serif typography stacked on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-text balance: The dancing figures occupy the right vertical third, while text blocks occupy the left two-thirds.
Color-to-mood: The use of muted red and green against white evokes a specific early 60s commercial aesthetic.
Pose-to-theme: The back-to-back dynamic pose creates a sense of movement and energy central to the 'twist' theme.
coreInvariants: High-key white background with subtle paper grain texture.
Full-body photography of subjects in 1960s formal/semi-formal attire.
Left-aligned text hierarchy with varying weights and colors.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are positioned on the right side of the frame, scaled to full height from top to bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, multi-colored display title at the top left acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the top-left title, down through the artist name, then across to the dancing couple, finally settling on the tracklist at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open white space in the center-left creates breathing room for the dense tracklist.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal/black for primary artist name and male subject's suit.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted sage green and brick red used alternatingly in the display title and sub-text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation colors with high value contrast against the white backdrop.

letterConstructionRules: Display type uses heavy, rounded geometric forms.
Secondary type uses condensed, bold grotesque forms.
Tertiary type uses light, wide-set sans-serif capitals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Alternating color fills within single words in the display title.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Triadic weight contrast: Heavy rounded display, bold condensed sub-header, and light wide tracklist.
graphicDevices: Boxed logo in top right corner

preserve: Alternating color fill in the top title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, heavy feel of the display title.
Matches the mid-century grotesque feel of the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a man in a dark 1960s suit and a woman in a light sweater and pencil skirt, dancing back-to-back in a 'twist' pose. The background is a flat, high-key white studio wall with a slight vintage paper texture. The couple is positioned on the right side of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of text on the left. Top: Large, heavy rounded sans-serif words stacked, with letters alternating between brick red and sage green with thin black outlines. Middle: Bold condensed charcoal sans-serif for the artist name. Bottom: A long list of song titles in a light, wide-set red sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white with a vintage texture?
Do the title letters alternate colors?
Is the couple positioned on the right third of the image?

adjustableVariables: Color of the alternating title letters
Specific dance pose of the couple
Density of the tracklist at the bottom
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles

mustAchieve: Dynamic sense of movement in the photography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subjects.
Verify the alternating color pattern in the display text.
Confirm the background is high-key white without distracting elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key studio portrait of a dancing couple on the right with a three-tiered left-aligned typographic stack using a muted red/green/charcoal palette on a textured white ground.
